decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Drawing Numbers D01 B, D42 A, D41 A, D40 A, D34 B, D33 B, D32 B, D31 B, D30 B, D26 B, D25 C, D12 B, D11 B, D10 B, D09 B, D08 B, D07 B, D06, D05 B, D04 B, D03 B, D02 B, Flood Risk Assessment, Drawings Numbers S01A, S02A, S03A, S04A, S05A, S06A, S07A, S08A, S09A, S10A, S11A, S12A, S30A, S31A, S32A, S33A, S34A, S40A, S41A, S42A, S100, received 27/01/11.
Drawing Numbers D20D, D21D, D22D, D23D, D24D, D27C,  received 19/08/11) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - Before the commencement of the development hereby permitted details of the brick(s) to be used, including samples if so required, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and all the brick(s) used in the development shall conform to the details/samples so approved.

Condition : 4 - No work permitted by this consent shall commence until a detailed specification of the proposed mortar mix has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out using the approved specification.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 6 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.

Condition : 7 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings

Condition : 8 - Other than those shown on the submitted drawings  under this listed building consent/planning permission, there shall be no external alterations to the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 9 - All new window frames, glazing bars and external doorframes shall be of timber construction, white painted with joinery profiles to match originals and thereafter so maintained.

Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, large scale details (at a scale of at least 1:20) of the following features shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and no work shall commence in advance of that approval. These details shall provide for a cross sectional detailed drawing at 1:20 scale for each feature and include methodology and the development shall be constructed in accordance with the details so approved:

The window/glazing units, including details of double glazing and fire glazing
The relocated dormer
The area of roof where the dormer is to be removed
The area of the roof where the valley gutter is to be masked
All rooflights, including those which are internal
The junction between the new extension and the garden walls, including details of windows, eaves and wall sections
The weatherboarding (and its joinery) on the extension and rear bay window
Joinery details of the French doors in the extension
the door below the valley gutter on the second floor from bedroom 4 to the en suite bathroom. 
Drawings of the extension into the lightwell.

Condition : 11 - The permitted works shall not take place until a scheme detailing measures to protect the safety and stability of the existing building during the works hereby permitted, which has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority has been implemented. Protection from the weather in accordance with the scheme shall be provided at all times during the progress of work.

Condition : 12 - Further details of all internal plumbing, drainage, pipework and any works to the service conduit shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works and shall be installed in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a single storey kitchen/family room to replace an existing part two storey part single storey rear extension with alterations to the roofscape and internal alterations. (listed building works)
